intro: Call of Water sends spiritual seekers into the Wetlands to learn the cleansing power of water and seek the water sapta. In a secluded cave beneath the southern falls, the dwarf Hervdana Saegrund greets travelers braving the wilderness.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If there's one truth ye need to learn about water, it's this: water means rebirth. It carves stone, cleanses filth, and heals the weary -- but only when it's pure. Taint it, and it'll ruin all it touches.
If ye seek the water sapta, find Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands. Her family dwells in a cave beneath the southern falls.
Go on then, don't let the river outrun ye.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Aye, I see it in yer eyes, dwarf. You're wonderin' what kind o' soul chooses to live out here, deep in the Wetlands, with Dark Iron scum lurkin' about and nary a guard in sight. Well, we all have our reasons, love.
But the real question is, what brings you to our home? Out here at the edge of the falls, I reckon we both know the answer to that.
Hervdana stretches out her arm, fingers catching mist spray from the waterfall.
